copy_chain.summary: Copy the best joker with Blueprint and Brainstorm.

deck_fattening.summary: Add cards for Hologram and Blue Joker.

deck_thinning.summary: Fewer cards means more of the good ones; Erosion and Ride the Bus.

economy.summary: Build money early, then sell for power.

face_cards.deck_edits: Thin number cards, add face cards.
face_cards.summary: Face joker stack, with Triboulet and Sock and Buskin.

five_kind.deck_edits: Make five copies of one card.
five_kind.summary: Copy one card into a stack; huge base score.

flush.deck_edits: Convert off suit cards to the main suit with suit tarots, add Wild cards, thin off suit.
flush.risks: Boss debuffs on a suit (Club, Goad, Head, Window); Water and Needle.
flush.stage: Easy by ante 2 on Checkered; mid run with Smeared and a suit joker.
flush.summary: Stack one or two suits and play flushes every hand.

four_kind.deck_edits: Cryptid and DNA copy a rank; thin the rest.

full_house.deck_edits: Keep two ranks heavy in the deck.
full_house.summary: Full house with Duo, Trio and Mad.

glass.deck_edits: Replace shattered glass; keep a stable core.
glass.summary: Glass cards with Oops and Caino or Glass Joker.

gold_economy.summary: Gold cards for end of round money.

high_card.deck_edits: Steel or Glass Kings held; Aces for Scholar.
high_card.summary: Play one card for huge chips or xMult.

lucky_cards.summary: Lucky cards with Oops and Lucky Cat for mult and money.

mult_stack.summary: Flat plus Mult to cover the xMult.

pair.deck_edits: Use Death and Strength to make duplicate ranks; Ouija for one rank.
pair.stage: Good from ante 1; plateaus around ante 6 without xMult.
pair.summary: Cheap and reliable: pair family xMult jokers.

planet_scaling.summary: Level one hand type a lot.

retrigger.summary: Retrigger scoring cards with Hanging Chad, Dusk and Sock and Buskin.

scaling_jokers.summary: Joker whose power grows over the run; buy early.

steel_kings.deck_edits: Steel on Kings, Red Seals, thin non Kings.
steel_kings.summary: Hold Steel Kings with Baron and Mime for held xMult.

stone.summary: Stone cards with Stone Joker for chips.

straight.deck_edits: Thin to consecutive ranks; remove duplicates.
straight.stage: Mid run once Shortcut is found.
straight.summary: Rank sequences made easier by Shortcut and Four Fingers.

survival.summary: Insurance against bosses and failed rounds.

tarot_scaling.summary: Use Tarots for Fortune Teller, Vampire or Driver's License.

three_kind.deck_edits: Stack a few ranks with Death.

two_pair.summary: Two pair and full house mult jokers.

bl_arm.name: The Arm
bl_arm.what: The Arm: decreases the level of the played poker hand by 1.
bl_arm.when: Dangerous for high level hands; vary hand type or use Luchador.

bl_club.name: The Club
bl_club.what: The Club: all Clubs are debuffed.
bl_club.when: Hurts Club flush plans; use Luchador or Chicot.

bl_eye.name: The Eye
bl_eye.what: The Eye: no repeat hand types this round.
bl_eye.when: Hurts one hand plans; keep two hand types ready.

bl_final_acorn.name: Amber Acorn
bl_final_acorn.what: Amber Acorn: flips and shuffles all jokers.
bl_final_acorn.when: Joker order is random after; Blueprint and Brainstorm may break.

bl_final_bell.name: Cerulean Bell
bl_final_bell.what: Cerulean Bell: forces one card to always be selected.
bl_final_bell.when: Plan hands that include a random card; hurts flush and straight plans.

bl_final_heart.name: Crimson Heart
bl_final_heart.what: Crimson Heart: a random joker is disabled each hand.
bl_final_heart.when: Spread power across several jokers; Luchador or Chicot help.

bl_final_leaf.name: Verdant Leaf
bl_final_leaf.what: Verdant Leaf: all cards are debuffed until a joker is sold.
bl_final_leaf.when: Sell a spare joker to clear it; keep a junk joker or Luchador ready.

bl_final_vessel.name: Violet Vessel
bl_final_vessel.when: Needs high xMult; the toughest blind size.

bl_fish.name: The Fish
bl_fish.what: The Fish: cards drawn face down after each hand played.
bl_fish.when: Play with fewer unknown cards; ok for deterministic plans.

bl_flint.name: The Flint
bl_flint.what: The Flint: base chips and Mult halved.
bl_flint.when: Level and xMult matter more; flat jokers still count.

bl_goad.name: The Goad
bl_goad.what: The Goad: all Spades are debuffed.

bl_head.name: The Head
bl_head.what: The Head: all Hearts are debuffed.

bl_hook.name: The Hook
bl_hook.what: The Hook: discards 2 random cards from hand after each hand played.
bl_hook.when: Plan to keep more cards in hand; dangerous for rank dependent jokers.

bl_house.name: The House
bl_house.what: The House: first hand drawn face down.
bl_house.when: Minor; avoid planning the first hand blind.

bl_manacle.name: The Manacle
bl_manacle.when: Hurts large hand plans; plan a 4 card hand.

bl_mark.name: The Mark
bl_mark.what: The Mark: all face cards drawn face down.
bl_mark.when: Hurts face card builds that need to see cards.

bl_mouth.name: The Mouth
bl_mouth.what: The Mouth: only one hand type can be played this round.
bl_mouth.when: Fine for single hand plans; hurts Obelisk and variety plans.

bl_needle.name: The Needle
bl_needle.what: The Needle: only 1 hand this round.
bl_needle.when: One hand must kill; needs score margin; use all burst. Strong with xMult and Burglar-less builds.

bl_ox.name: The Ox
bl_ox.what: The Ox: playing your most played hand type sets money to $0.
bl_ox.when: Avoid the most played hand if you hold cash, or spend before. Be ready with a second hand type.

bl_pillar.name: The Pillar
bl_pillar.what: The Pillar: cards played previously this ante are debuffed.
bl_pillar.when: Hurts reusing the same cards; have deep deck variety.

bl_plant.name: The Plant
bl_plant.what: The Plant: all face cards are debuffed.
bl_plant.when: Hurts face card builds; Luchador is good.

bl_psychic.name: The Psychic
bl_psychic.when: Hurts High Card and pair plans that use fewer cards; play junk fillers or use Splash.

bl_serpent.name: The Serpent
bl_serpent.what: The Serpent: after play or discard always draw back to 3 cards.
bl_serpent.when: Hurts hand size based plans; the hand shrinks.

bl_tooth.name: The Tooth
bl_tooth.what: The Tooth: lose $1 per card played.
bl_tooth.when: Play fewer cards; keep money; Matador likes it.

bl_wall.name: The Wall
bl_wall.what: The Wall: extra large blind (4x base score).
bl_wall.when: Needs real scoring margin; plan xMult before it.

bl_water.name: The Water
bl_water.when: Hurts flush and straight plans that dig; discard heavy jokers fail.

bl_wheel.name: The Wheel
bl_wheel.what: The Wheel: 1 in 7 cards drawn face down.

bl_window.name: The Window
bl_window.what: The Window: all Diamonds are debuffed.

b_abandoned.what: Abandoned Deck: no face cards (40 card deck).
b_abandoned.when: Good for Ride the Bus, Erosion and straight plans, bad for face joker plans.

b_anaglyph.what: Anaglyph Deck: gain a Double Tag after defeating each Boss Blind.

b_black.what: Black Deck: +1 joker slot, -1 hand each round.
b_black.when: Strong with xMult jokers; the lost hand hurts.

b_blue.when: A balanced starter for scaling jokers that like hands.

b_challenge.what: Challenge Deck: used by challenge runs only; rules come from the challenge.

b_checkered.what: Checkered Deck: 26 Spades and 26 Hearts only.
b_checkered.when: Easy flush; use Smeared Joker plans and Blackboard.

b_erratic.what: Erratic Deck: random ranks and suits.
b_erratic.when: Often many pairs and flush; thin and trim to a build. Favors pair stack and five of a kind chances.

b_ghost.what: Ghost Deck: Spectral cards can appear in the shop, start with a Hex.
b_ghost.when: Spectral cards allow Familiar, Cryptid and Black Hole plans; Hex wipes jokers so use on a single strong joker.

b_green.what: Green Deck: $2 per remaining hand and $1 per remaining discard at end of round, no interest.
b_green.when: Economy from unused hands and discards; play efficiently and do not rely on interest jokers.

b_magic.what: Magic Deck: start with Crystal Ball and 2 copies of The Fool.
b_magic.when: Good for consumable builds; the extra slot helps tarot scaling.

b_nebula.what: Nebula Deck: start with Telescope, -1 consumable slot.
b_nebula.when: Strong planet scaling for one hand plans.

b_painted.what: Painted Deck: +2 hand size, -1 joker slot.
b_painted.when: Big hand size helps flush and straight plans; joker slots are tight so quality over quantity.

b_plasma.what: Plasma Deck: balances Chips and Mult, blind sizes are 2x.
b_plasma.when: Reward high chips plus mult together; flat Mult joker lose value, chips rich plans do better.

b_red.when: A balanced starter for flush and straight plans.

b_yellow.when: Early economy; take shop buys at ante 1.

b_zodiac.what: Zodiac Deck: start with Tarot Merchant, Planet Merchant and Overstock.
b_zodiac.when: Good for tarot or planet scaling.

e_foil.when: Weak but never wasted; good on a joker early or a card you always score.

e_holo.when: Good on any joker or a card you always score; ok before ante 5.

e_negative.what: Negative: +1 joker slot (jokers) or +1 consumable slot (consumables).
e_negative.when: Always good; extra slot. Wins on copy jokers and Perkeo.

e_polychrome.when: Best edition on a scoring card or joker; sits as a multiplier on its own.

m_bonus.name: Bonus
m_bonus.when: Low impact; use with Driver's License.

m_glass.name: Glass Card
m_glass.what: Glass: X2 Mult when scored; 1 in 4 chance to shatter.
m_glass.when: Fast power; thin with a Hanged Man, strong with Oops, Glass Joker and Caino.

m_gold.name: Gold Card
m_gold.what: Gold: $3 if held in hand at end of round.
m_gold.when: Economy build; combine with Midas Mask and Ticket.

m_lucky.name: Lucky Card
m_lucky.what: Lucky: 1 in 5 chance of +20 Mult, 1 in 15 chance of $20.
m_lucky.when: Needs Oops and Lucky Cat for real power; otherwise average.

m_mult.name: Mult
m_mult.when: Steady; fine on cards you always play.

m_steel.name: Steel Card
m_steel.what: Steel: X1.5 Mult while held in hand.
m_steel.when: Core of steel builds; stack on Kings with Baron and Mime.

m_stone.name: Stone Card
m_stone.what: Stone: +50 Chips, no rank or suit, always scores.
m_stone.when: Core of stone builds; good with Stone Joker. Hurts flush and straight chances.

m_wild.name: Wild Card
m_wild.when: Great for flush, Ancient, Flower Pot and Seeing Double. Always scores a flush.

Five of a Kind.what: 5 cards of the same rank. Base 120 x 12. Secret hand; Planet is Planet X.
Five of a Kind.when: Needs duplicate ranks from Cryptid, Death or Familiar.

Flush.what: 5 cards of the same suit. Base 35 x 4. Planet is Jupiter.
Flush.when: Easy to reach with a suit heavy deck; most reliable early xMult support.

Flush Five.what: 5 cards of the same rank and suit. Base 160 Chips x 16 Mult. Secret hand; Planet is Eris.
Flush Five.when: Rarely made without Cryptid or a Death built stack; huge when it works.

Flush House.what: Full House with all five cards of the same suit. Base 140 x 14. Secret hand; Planet is Ceres.
Flush House.when: Hard to build; very strong on decks with suit and rank stacks.

Four of a Kind.what: 4 cards of the same rank. Base 60 x 7. Planet is Mars.
Four of a Kind.when: Needs rank stacks; with The Family a strong build.

Full House.what: Three of a kind plus a pair. Base 40 x 4. Planet is Earth.
Full House.when: Strong with Duo, Trio and Mad jokers; contains both Pair and Three of a Kind.

High Card.what: The best single card. Base 5 x 1. Planet is Pluto.
High Card.when: Only scores one card (without Splash); strong with Stuntman, Half Joker and Scholar.

Pair.what: Two cards of the same rank. Base 10 x 2. Planet is Mercury.
Pair.when: Easiest hand; strong with Duo, Jolly and Splash.

Straight.what: 5 sequential cards. Base 30 x 4. Planet is Saturn.
Straight.when: Aces count high or low; Shortcut and Four Fingers help.

Straight Flush.what: 5 sequential cards of one suit. Base 100 x 8. Planet is Neptune.
Straight Flush.when: Plays as both Straight and Flush for jokers; good with Four Fingers and Shortcut.

Three of a Kind.what: 3 cards of the same rank. Base 30 x 3. Planet is Venus.
Three of a Kind.when: Moderate; contains Pair so Pair jokers also fire.

Two Pair.what: Two different pairs. Base 20 x 2. Planet is Uranus.
Two Pair.when: Weak base; jokers like Mad and Trousers make it viable.

j_8_ball.name: 8 Ball
j_8_ball.what: 1 in 4 chance for each scored 8 to create a Tarot card.
j_8_ball.when: Only worth it in a deck full of 8s, for tarot scaling builds. Needs consumable room.

j_abstract.name: Abstract Joker
j_abstract.when: Good in a full board of cheap jokers, up to +18 with five and more with Negatives. Pair with Riff-Raff and Negative jokers.

j_acrobat.name: Acrobat
j_acrobat.what: X3 Mult on the final hand of the round.
j_acrobat.when: Strong; plan the last hand as the big hand. Pair with Dusk.

j_ancient.name: Ancient Joker
j_ancient.what: Each played card of a random suit (changes each round) gives X1.5 Mult when scored.
j_ancient.when: Strong in flush builds that match the suit; with Smeared, and wild cards, it scores nearly always. Good mid run.

j_arrowhead.name: Arrowhead
j_arrowhead.when: Strong chips in Spade flush plans.

j_astronomer.name: Astronomer
j_astronomer.what: All Planet cards and Celestial Packs in the shop are free.
j_astronomer.when: Strong in planet scaling and Constellation builds. Skip otherwise.

j_banner.name: Banner
j_banner.when: Good early with Red and Blue-less setups, with extra discards from Wasteful or Drunkard. Falls off once you need all discards.

j_baron.name: Baron
j_baron.what: Each King held in hand gives X1.5 Mult.
j_baron.when: Core of steel kings builds; with Mime it doubles. Needs Kings, Steel cards and Mime or Blueprint.

j_baseball.name: Baseball Card
j_baseball.what: Uncommon jokers each give X1.5 Mult.
j_baseball.when: Very strong with a board full of Uncommons; plan around Uncommon Tags. Worth building around.

j_blackboard.name: Blackboard
j_blackboard.what: X3 Mult if all held cards are Spades or Clubs.
j_blackboard.when: Strong in Black suit decks with Smeared Joker and deck thinning toward Spades and Clubs. Needs hand to be empty or black only.

j_bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
j_bloodstone.what: Scored Hearts have a 1 in 2 chance to give X1.5 Mult.
j_bloodstone.when: Strong in Heart flush plans; Oops all 6s makes it always. Retriggers also help.

j_blue_joker.name: Blue Joker
j_blue_joker.what: +2 Chips for each card left in the deck.
j_blue_joker.when: Better with a bigger deck; fine mid run on a non-thinned deck, loses to thinning.

j_blueprint.name: Blueprint
j_blueprint.what: Copies the ability of the joker to its right.
j_blueprint.when: Put it directly left of your best xMult or retrigger joker. Take almost always; the best copy piece. Keep jokers to its right stable and not Eternal-less sold.

j_bootstraps.name: Bootstraps
j_bootstraps.when: Strong with an economy engine; Seed Money, Money Tree, To the Moon.

j_brainstorm.name: Brainstorm
j_brainstorm.what: Copies the ability of the leftmost joker.
j_brainstorm.when: Put it as the second joker with your best xMult first. Strong with Baron and Mime plans and Photograph.

j_bull.name: Bull
j_bull.when: Good with an economy build that holds a lot of money; scales with Money Tree.

j_burglar.name: Burglar
j_burglar.what: On blind select gain 3 hands and lose all discards.
j_burglar.when: Good with hand-only plans like Mystic Summit, Delayed Gratification-less builds; bad if you need discards for flushes.

j_burnt.name: Burnt Joker
j_burnt.what: Upgrades the level of the first discarded poker hand each round.
j_burnt.when: Good with a single hand type you discard and play; compounds with levels.

j_business.name: Business Card
j_business.what: Scored face cards have a 1 in 2 chance to give $2.
j_business.when: Good economy for face heavy decks; Pareidolia doubles its reach. Sell when money stops mattering.

j_caino.name: Caino
j_caino.what: Gains X1 Mult when a face card is destroyed.
j_caino.when: Legendary; strong with Glass face cards and Hanged Man on faces.

j_campfire.name: Campfire
j_campfire.what: Gains X0.25 Mult for each card sold; resets after beating a boss.
j_campfire.when: Strong if you sell cheap cards regularly and it resets on boss win; timing around the boss. Take mid run with extra fodder.

j_card_sharp.name: Card Sharp
j_card_sharp.what: X3 Mult if the played poker hand has already been played this round.
j_card_sharp.when: Strong with a single hand type you repeat; weak if you switch hands or are 1 hand rounds. Needs hand reserve.

j_cartomancer.name: Cartomancer
j_cartomancer.what: Creates a Tarot card when the blind is selected.
j_cartomancer.when: Good for tarot supply, but needs consumable slot.

j_castle.name: Castle
j_castle.what: Gains +3 Chips for each discarded card of a random suit that changes each round.
j_castle.when: Good in discard heavy plans; slow chips.

j_cavendish.name: Cavendish
j_cavendish.what: X3 Mult; 1 in 1000 chance to be destroyed at end of round.
j_cavendish.when: One of the best common xMult jokers; keep for the whole run. Only appears after Gros Michel is gone in vanilla.

j_ceremonial.name: Ceremonial Dagger
j_ceremonial.what: Destroys the joker to its right on blind select and gains Mult equal to double its sell value.
j_ceremonial.when: Risky, needs fodder like Egg, Gift Card or Gros Michel residue. Good mid run if you have junk jokers and a free slot; always check what sits to the right.

j_certificate.name: Certificate
j_certificate.what: Adds a random card with a random seal to your hand each round.
j_certificate.when: Good for deck fattening; stronger with Hologram and Glass or Steel plans. Free seals are strong.

j_chaos.name: Chaos the Clown
j_chaos.when: Minor economy; helps hunting in shops where you reroll anyway. Skip unless you have nothing.

j_chicot.name: Chicot
j_chicot.what: Disables the effect of every Boss Blind.
j_chicot.when: Legendary; removes boss risk, good for any build.

j_clever.name: Clever Joker
j_clever.what: +80 Chips if the played hand contains Two Pair.
j_clever.when: Cheap chips for two pair builds; low priority after ante 4.

j_cloud_9.name: Cloud 9
j_cloud_9.what: Earn $1 for each 9 in the full deck at end of round.
j_cloud_9.when: Strong economy in 9 heavy decks; thinning other ranks boosts it. Early pick on Ghost or Erratic decks.

j_constellation.name: Constellation
j_constellation.what: Gains X0.1 Mult each time a Planet card is used.
j_constellation.when: Strong in planet scaling builds with many planet packs; slow if you only use a few planets.

j_crafty.name: Crafty Joker
j_crafty.what: +80 Chips if the played hand contains a Flush.
j_crafty.when: Cheap chips for flush builds; low priority after ante 4.

j_crazy.name: Crazy Joker
j_crazy.what: +12 Mult if the played hand contains a Straight.
j_crazy.when: Early pickup for a straight plan; pair with Shortcut and Four Fingers.

j_credit_card.name: Credit Card
j_credit_card.what: Lets you go up to $20 in debt.
j_credit_card.when: Take only as a free early slot filler when you need a key buy; sell as soon as a real joker is better. Weak on high stakes where every slot counts.

j_delayed_grat.name: Delayed Gratification
j_delayed_grat.what: Earn $2 per unused discard at end of round if no discards were used.
j_delayed_grat.when: Good economy on Green-light stakes if you win in hands only; poor if you rely on discards. Stack with Banner decisions carefully.

j_devious.name: Devious Joker
j_devious.what: +100 Chips if the played hand contains a Straight.
j_devious.when: Cheap chips for straight builds; low priority after ante 4.

j_diet_cola.name: Diet Cola
j_diet_cola.what: Sell this to create a free Double Tag.
j_diet_cola.when: Decent to sell for a Double Tag with a good skip tag. Do not hold for long; value is in selling.

j_dna.name: DNA
j_dna.what: If the first hand of the round has exactly one card, add a copy of it to the deck.
j_dna.when: Strong deck fattening in single card hands (High Card, Face-card plans) and for building a Steel or Glass stack. Pair with Hologram.

j_drivers_license.name: Driver's License
j_drivers_license.what: X3 Mult if you have at least 16 Enhanced cards in your full deck.
j_drivers_license.when: Strong in enhancement-heavy decks with Tarot and Spectrals; needs 16 enhanced cards. Hard before ante 4.

j_droll.name: Droll Joker
j_droll.what: +10 Mult if the played hand contains a Flush.
j_droll.when: Early pickup for a flush plan, stays decent through ante 5.

j_drunkard.name: Drunkard
j_drunkard.when: Good for flush and straight plans that dig; pair with Banner.

j_duo.name: The Duo
j_duo.what: X2 Mult if the played hand contains a Pair.
j_duo.when: Strong in pair builds; stacks with the other family jokers by hand type.

j_dusk.name: Dusk
j_dusk.what: Retriggers all played cards on the final hand of the round.
j_dusk.when: Strong for burst on the last hand, especially with scaling cards like Hiker and Lucky. Pair with Acrobat to make the last hand the big hand.

j_egg.name: Egg
j_egg.what: Gains $3 sell value at end of each round.
j_egg.when: Slow economy; sell it when you need money or Ceremonial and Swashbuckler value. Hold it early on a plan with spare slot.

j_erosion.name: Erosion
j_erosion.what: +4 Mult for each card below 52 in the full deck.
j_erosion.when: Strong with deck thinning (Hanged Man, Immolate). Bad with deck fattening.

j_even_steven.name: Even Steven
j_even_steven.what: Even ranked scored cards (10, 8, 6, 4, 2) give +4 Mult.
j_even_steven.when: Fine in decks with many even cards; works with deck thinning of odds. Pair with Hack.

j_faceless.name: Faceless Joker
j_faceless.what: Earn $5 if 3 or more face cards are discarded at once.
j_faceless.when: Good economy for face decks; Pareidolia makes it trivial. Fine early.

j_family.name: The Family
j_family.what: X4 Mult if the played hand contains Four of a Kind.
j_family.when: Strong for a four of a kind plan, with Cryptid and DNA deck stacking.

j_fibonacci.name: Fibonacci
j_fibonacci.what: Scored Ace, 2, 3, 5 and 8 give +8 Mult each.
j_fibonacci.when: Strong mult for five scoring cards of those ranks; good with Hack and rank stacks. Gets better with Sock and Buskin only on faces, not here.

j_flash.name: Flash Card
j_flash.what: Gains +2 Mult for each shop reroll.
j_flash.when: Strong with Chaos and Reroll Surplus; great in a reroll heavy economy build.

j_flower_pot.name: Flower Pot
j_flower_pot.what: X3 Mult if the played hand contains a Diamond, Club, Heart and Spade card.
j_flower_pot.when: Strong with Wild cards and in four suit full hands; Smeared hurts it. Needs scoring cards of every suit; Wild and Splash help.

j_fortune_teller.name: Fortune Teller
j_fortune_teller.what: Gains +1 Mult for each Tarot card used this run.
j_fortune_teller.when: Good in tarot scaling builds. Slow without many tarots.

j_four_fingers.name: Four Fingers
j_four_fingers.what: Flushes and Straights can be made with 4 cards.
j_four_fingers.when: Big enabler for flush and straight plans, and lets you hold the 5th card as a discard dig. Take early if you are on either.

j_gift.name: Gift Card
j_gift.what: Adds $1 of sell value to every joker and consumable at end of round.
j_gift.when: Value joker for Ceremonial, Swashbuckler, Temperance and selling. Take with Egg for long runs.

j_glass.name: Glass Joker
j_glass.what: Gains X0.75 Mult for each Glass card destroyed.
j_glass.when: Good in glass card builds; each shatter grows it. Stronger with Justice and Vampire-free decks.

j_gluttenous_joker.name: Gluttonous Joker
j_gluttenous_joker.when: Good in a Club flush plan or with Smeared Joker and Onyx Agate. Skip otherwise.

j_golden.name: Golden Joker
j_golden.when: Reliable economy; sell once the board needs power.

j_greedy_joker.name: Greedy Joker
j_greedy_joker.when: Only good in a Diamond flush plan or with Smeared Joker. Skip otherwise.

j_green_joker.name: Green Joker
j_green_joker.what: Gains +1 Mult per hand played and loses 1 per discard.
j_green_joker.when: Good if you rarely discard; strong in hand heavy builds. Weak in flush plans that discard.

j_gros_michel.name: Gros Michel
j_gros_michel.what: +15 Mult; 1 in 6 chance to be destroyed at end of round.
j_gros_michel.when: Strong early mult for ante 1 to 4, then expires. Once it is gone Cavendish appears in the pool. Great with Ceremonial fodder.

j_hack.name: Hack
j_hack.when: Good with low rank decks and Fibonacci; weak elsewhere.

j_half.name: Half Joker
j_half.what: +20 Mult when the played hand has 3 or fewer cards.
j_half.when: Strong early for High Card, Pair and three card trips plans; dies when you play five card hands. Fine until ante 5.

j_hallucination.name: Hallucination
j_hallucination.what: 1 in 2 chance to create a Tarot when a Booster Pack is opened.
j_hallucination.when: Good with Arcana and Celestial pack heavy builds and Red Card. Needs consumable room.

j_hanging_chad.name: Hanging Chad
j_hanging_chad.what: Retriggers the first scored card two additional times.
j_hanging_chad.when: Strong with Hiker, Lucky and glass first-card plans; and for steel scoring cards. Great mid run.

j_hiker.name: Hiker
j_hiker.what: Every played scoring card permanently gains +5 Chips.
j_hiker.when: Strong early in a pair, flush, or high card plan; the chips stay in the deck. Retriggers make it better.

j_hit_the_road.name: Hit the Road
j_hit_the_road.what: Gains X0.5 Mult for each Jack discarded this round; resets each round.
j_hit_the_road.when: Strong in Jack heavy decks and discard plans. Needs Jacks in the deck.

j_hologram.name: Hologram
j_hologram.what: Gains X0.25 Mult for each playing card added to the deck.
j_hologram.when: Very strong with DNA, Marble, Certificate, Cryptid, Familiar and Grim. Good from ante 1 in deck fattening builds.

j_ice_cream.name: Ice Cream
j_ice_cream.what: +100 Chips, loses 5 Chips per hand played.
j_ice_cream.when: Good in ante 1 to 3 for early kills; sell by ante 4.

j_idol.name: The Idol
j_idol.what: Each played card of a random rank and suit (changes each round) gives X2 Mult when scored.
j_idol.when: Strong with the right card; you can build it with Cryptid or pairs of that card. Needs deck knowledge.

j_invisible.name: Invisible Joker
j_invisible.what: After 2 rounds, selling it duplicates a random joker.
j_invisible.when: Keep for 2 rounds, then sell with a good joker on board; the copy can be your best xMult. Randomly selected, keep only good jokers.

j_joker.name: Joker
j_joker.when: Filler in ante 1 to 3; replace as soon as a real scaler or xMult shows up. Sell value is 1.

j_jolly.name: Jolly Joker
j_jolly.what: +8 Mult if the played hand contains a Pair.
j_jolly.when: Cheap early mult for any pair based plan; contains Pair so it also fires on trips, two pair and full house. Replace by ante 5.

j_juggler.name: Juggler
j_juggler.when: Cheap and always useful; keep early.

j_loyalty_card.name: Loyalty Card
j_loyalty_card.when: Reliable xMult on every 6th hand if you plan the counter; do not waste hand count. Takes it from decent to strong when you can time it for a boss.

j_luchador.name: Luchador
j_luchador.what: Sell this to disable the current boss blind.
j_luchador.when: Insurance for a boss that kills the build. Hold it for ante 6 to 8 bosses and use it when the boss wrecks your hand plan. Best save for ante 8.

j_lucky_cat.name: Lucky Cat
j_lucky_cat.what: Gains X0.25 Mult each time a Lucky card triggers.
j_lucky_cat.when: Strong in lucky card builds with Oops all 6s and retriggers.

j_lusty_joker.name: Lusty Joker
j_lusty_joker.when: Good in a Heart flush plan, with Smeared Joker, Bloodstone or Lucky Cat setups. Skip otherwise.

j_mad.name: Mad Joker
j_mad.what: +10 Mult if the played hand contains Two Pair.
j_mad.when: Fine with two pair and full house builds; Spare Trousers pairs with it.

j_madness.name: Madness
j_madness.what: On blind select (not boss) gains X0.5 Mult and destroys a random joker.
j_madness.when: Dangerous. Great with fodder jokers and Negative; protect Blueprint and key jokers with Eternal-free setups. Risk grows on high stakes.

j_mail.name: Mail-In Rebate
j_mail.what: Earn $5 for each discarded card of a random rank that changes each round.
j_mail.when: Good in discard heavy plans; unreliable value.

j_marble.name: Marble Joker
j_marble.what: Adds a Stone card to the deck on each blind select.
j_marble.when: Slow deck thickening for Stone builds and Hologram; the stones cost you deck consistency. Good with Stone Joker and Steel decks that want chips.

j_matador.name: Matador
j_matador.what: Earn $8 if a played hand triggers the Boss Blind ability.
j_matador.when: Niche; good against bosses that trigger on play such as The Tooth. Do not buy as a general economy joker.

j_merry_andy.name: Merry Andy
j_merry_andy.when: Great for digging in flush and straight plans; the hand size cost is real. Combine with Juggler.

j_midas_mask.name: Midas Mask
j_midas_mask.what: Played face cards become Gold cards.
j_midas_mask.when: Good with Pareidolia, Gold economy, Business Card and Gold deck plans. Gold cards held in hand give $3.

j_mime.name: Mime
j_mime.when: Core of steel kings and baron builds. Weak without held-in-hand effects.

j_misprint.name: Misprint
j_misprint.what: Random +0 to +23 Mult each hand, average 11.5.
j_misprint.when: Cheap and fine mult early; random scoring hurts exact kill planning.

j_mr_bones.name: Mr. Bones
j_mr_bones.what: Prevents death if you reach at least 25% of the blind score, then self destructs.
j_mr_bones.when: Good insurance for the final antes; buy when a boss threatens to end the run. Hold for ante 7 and 8.

j_mystic_summit.name: Mystic Summit
j_mystic_summit.what: +15 Mult when you have 0 discards left.
j_mystic_summit.when: Good with burn-all-discards play or with Burglar and Water-like effects; fine at ante 2 to 5. Pair with Hit the Road and Trading Card style discard use.

j_obelisk.name: Obelisk
j_obelisk.what: Gains X0.2 Mult for each consecutive hand played that is not your most played hand type.
j_obelisk.when: Works when you vary hand types; opposite of stacking a single hand type. Beware: cannot be combined with a one hand plan.

j_odd_todd.name: Odd Todd
j_odd_todd.what: Odd ranked scored cards (A, 9, 7, 5, 3) give +31 Chips.
j_odd_todd.when: Good chips for odd rank decks; pair with Fibonacci and Hack overlap on A, 3, 5.

j_oops.name: Oops! All 6s
j_oops.when: Core of lucky card, Bloodstone, 8 Ball, Glass and Wheel of Fortune builds.

j_order.name: The Order
j_order.what: X3 Mult if the played hand contains a Straight.
j_order.when: Strong in straight builds with Shortcut.

j_pareidolia.name: Pareidolia
j_pareidolia.what: All cards are considered face cards.
j_pareidolia.when: Turns every face joker on and makes Business Card, Faceless, Photograph, Triboulet work on everything. Needs those jokers to matter.

j_perkeo.name: Perkeo
j_perkeo.what: Creates a Negative copy of 1 random consumable at end of the shop.
j_perkeo.when: Legendary; great with planets and tarots like The Fool and Strength setups. Doubles consumables each shop; strong in planet scaling.

j_photograph.name: Photograph
j_photograph.what: The first played face card gives X2 Mult when scored.
j_photograph.when: Good in face card builds; retriggers on that first card apply twice more. Pareidolia and Sock and Buskin help.

j_popcorn.name: Popcorn
j_popcorn.when: Short lived early mult for ante 1 to 4; sell when it is nearly gone.

j_raised_fist.name: Raised Fist
j_raised_fist.what: Adds double the rank of the lowest held card to Mult.
j_raised_fist.when: Okay early; better with Mime and a hand that holds low cards. Weak in flush builds that hold arbitrary ranks.

j_ramen.name: Ramen
j_ramen.what: X2 Mult, loses X0.01 per card discarded.
j_ramen.when: Good if you discard little; loses value in discard heavy play.

j_red_card.name: Red Card
j_red_card.what: Gains +3 Mult when any Booster Pack is skipped.
j_red_card.when: Good if you skip packs anyway; passable scaling. Buy early.

j_reserved_parking.name: Reserved Parking
j_reserved_parking.what: Each face card held in hand has a 1 in 2 chance to give $1.
j_reserved_parking.when: Good economy for hand holding face cards, with Mime retrigger. Pareidolia helps.

j_ride_the_bus.name: Ride the Bus
j_ride_the_bus.what: Gains +1 Mult each consecutive hand played without a scoring face card; resets on a face.
j_ride_the_bus.when: Very strong in decks without faces (Abandoned deck, face thinned) and high card or flush with low cards. Strong from ante 1.

j_riff_raff.name: Riff-raff
j_riff_raff.what: On blind select creates 2 Common jokers if there is room.
j_riff_raff.when: Great fodder for Madness, Ceremonial, Abstract and Stencil-less boards. Fills the board early.

j_ring_master.name: Showman
j_ring_master.what: Joker, Tarot, Planet and Spectral cards may appear multiple times.
j_ring_master.when: Niche; lets you stack duplicates like multiple Blueprints. Rarely worth a slot.

j_rocket.name: Rocket
j_rocket.what: Earn $1 at end of round; payout rises by $2 each boss blind defeated.
j_rocket.when: Good early economy that scales. Keep until ante 6 or so.

j_rough_gem.name: Rough Gem
j_rough_gem.when: Good in a Diamond flush plan economy.

j_runner.name: Runner
j_runner.what: Gains +15 Chips when a Straight is played.
j_runner.when: Strong for a straight plan, early to mid run.

j_satellite.name: Satellite
j_satellite.what: Earn $1 at end of round for each unique Planet card used this run.
j_satellite.when: Good in planet builds early; scales with Celestial packs.

j_scary_face.name: Scary Face
j_scary_face.when: Cheap chips for face builds; Pareidolia makes every card count.

j_scholar.name: Scholar
j_scholar.what: Scored Aces give +20 Chips and +4 Mult.
j_scholar.when: Good with Ace stacks and Pair/High Card builds; keep Aces in deck.

j_seance.name: Seance
j_seance.what: Creates a Spectral card if a Straight Flush is played.
j_seance.when: Niche; only for straight flush plans.

j_seeing_double.name: Seeing Double
j_seeing_double.what: X2 Mult if the played hand has a scoring Club and a scoring card of another suit.
j_seeing_double.when: Good in Club heavy mixed suit builds; Wild cards help.

j_selzer.name: Seltzer
j_selzer.what: Retriggers all played cards for the next 10 hands, then breaks.
j_selzer.when: Strong temporary retrigger; good for a push on a boss or ante 8. Pair with Hiker.

j_shoot_the_moon.name: Shoot the Moon
j_shoot_the_moon.what: Each Queen held in hand gives +13 Mult.
j_shoot_the_moon.when: Good with Mime, and Queen holding builds; Pareidolia irrelevant.

j_shortcut.name: Shortcut
j_shortcut.what: Straights can be made with gaps of 1 rank.
j_shortcut.when: Core of straight builds; make straights easy with rank thin decks. Pair with Four Fingers.

j_sixth_sense.name: Sixth Sense
j_sixth_sense.what: If the first hand of the round is a single 6, destroy it and create a Spectral.
j_sixth_sense.when: Good with 6s and Oops. Thins deck and gets spectrals, but needs a 6 in the first draw.

j_sly.name: Sly Joker
j_sly.what: +50 Chips if the played hand contains a Pair.
j_sly.when: Weak alone; only worth it as a cheap early pair piece. Pairs with Jolly.

j_smeared.name: Smeared Joker
j_smeared.what: Hearts and Diamonds count as the same suit; Spades and Clubs count as the same.
j_smeared.when: Huge for flush: you only need two suits worth of cards. Take for flush plans mid run.

j_smiley.name: Smiley Face
j_smiley.when: Good in face builds; Pareidolia and Sock and Buskin help.

j_sock_and_buskin.name: Sock and Buskin
j_sock_and_buskin.when: Core of face card builds. Pair with Pareidolia.

j_space.name: Space Joker
j_space.what: 1 in 4 chance to upgrade the level of the played hand.
j_space.when: Good with a hand type you play every time; compounds with planet scaling.

j_splash.name: Splash
j_splash.what: Every played card counts as scoring.
j_splash.when: Good in pair and trips builds to score the kicker cards, and with scoring based jokers. Weak when high card quality matters.

j_square.name: Square Joker
j_square.what: Gains +4 Chips if the played hand has exactly 4 cards.
j_square.when: Good with Four Fingers and four card hands. Slow chip scaling.

j_steel_joker.name: Steel Joker
j_steel_joker.what: Gains X0.2 Mult for each Steel card in the full deck.
j_steel_joker.when: Core of steel builds; value scales with Steel cards from Chariot. Take early if you will make 4 or more steel cards.

j_stencil.name: Joker Stencil
j_stencil.what: X1 Mult for each empty joker slot, counting itself.
j_stencil.when: Best with few jokers: one big xMult joker and empty slots, or Negative jokers do not fill slots. Terrible in a full board. Strong on Black, Antimatter and Painted decks only if you keep slots empty.

j_stone.name: Stone Joker
j_stone.what: Gains +25 Chips for each Stone card in the full deck.
j_stone.when: Core of stone builds; pair with Marble and Tower.

j_stuntman.name: Stuntman
j_stuntman.when: Strong for chip heavy builds; the hand size loss hurts flush and straight plans. Pair with Juggler and Troubadour; best with high card.

j_supernova.name: Supernova
j_supernova.what: Adds the number of times the played hand type was played this run to Mult.
j_supernova.when: Strong for focusing on one hand type for the whole run; scales slowly but steadily. Good with a flush or pair stack plan from ante 1.

j_superposition.name: Superposition
j_superposition.what: Creates a Tarot card if a played hand contains an Ace and a Straight.
j_superposition.when: Fine in straight plans with Aces for tarot supply.

j_swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
j_swashbuckler.what: Adds the sell value of all other owned jokers to Mult.
j_swashbuckler.when: Good with Egg, Gift Card and valuable jokers; mid power. Selling other jokers lowers it.

j_throwback.name: Throwback
j_throwback.what: Gains X0.25 Mult for each blind skipped this run.
j_throwback.when: Good if you skip blinds for tags; skip tags like Investment or Voucher. Strong in a skip heavy plan.

j_ticket.name: Golden Ticket
j_ticket.when: Good in a Gold card plan; Midas Mask makes it work.

j_to_the_moon.name: To the Moon
j_to_the_moon.what: Earn an extra $1 of interest per $5 held, up to the interest cap.
j_to_the_moon.when: Doubles interest: strong for an economy build early; vouchers Seed Money and Money Tree make it huge. Sell once power matters.

j_todo_list.name: To Do List
j_todo_list.what: Earn $4 if the played hand matches a random target hand type, which changes each round.
j_todo_list.when: Small economy; needs flexible hand types. Skip in one hand plans unless the plan matches.

j_trading.name: Trading Card
j_trading.what: If the first discard is a single card, destroy it and earn $3.
j_trading.when: Good economy and deck thinning in discard plans.

j_tribe.name: The Tribe
j_tribe.what: X2 Mult if the played hand contains a Flush.

j_triboulet.name: Triboulet
j_triboulet.what: Played Kings and Queens each give X2 Mult when scored.
j_triboulet.when: Legendary; wins face card builds, Pareidolia makes it work on every card. Retriggers double it.

j_trio.name: The Trio
j_trio.what: X3 Mult if the played hand contains Three of a Kind.
j_trio.when: Strong in trips and full house builds.

j_troubadour.name: Troubadour
j_troubadour.when: Good for flush and straight plans with enough extra hands; risky otherwise.

j_trousers.name: Spare Trousers
j_trousers.what: Gains +2 Mult if the played hand contains Two Pair.
j_trousers.when: Good in two pair and full house builds.

j_turtle_bean.name: Turtle Bean
j_turtle_bean.when: Short term burst; great for one big blind, then sells. Useful before a boss that needs a big hand.

j_vagabond.name: Vagabond
j_vagabond.what: Creates a Tarot card if you have $4 or less when playing a hand.
j_vagabond.when: Fine for tarot supply when poor; conflicts with interest.

j_vampire.name: Vampire
j_vampire.what: Gains X0.1 Mult per scored Enhanced card and removes the enhancement.
j_vampire.when: Strong with many enhanced cards but removes steel, glass and lucky. Pair with Hiker-like cards and Tarot supply; not with Steel or Glass builds.

j_walkie_talkie.name: Walkie Talkie
j_walkie_talkie.what: Scored 10s and 4s give +10 Chips and +4 Mult.
j_walkie_talkie.when: Fine with 10 and 4 heavy decks and Fibonacci-like combos; Hack retriggers it.

j_wee.name: Wee Joker
j_wee.what: Gains +8 Chips each time a 2 is scored.
j_wee.when: Good with 2 heavy decks and retriggers like Hack, Hanging Chad; fast chip scaling in a deck thinned to low cards.

j_wily.name: Wily Joker
j_wily.what: +100 Chips if the played hand contains Three of a Kind.
j_wily.when: Cheap chips for trips builds; low priority after ante 4.

j_wrathful_joker.name: Wrathful Joker
j_wrathful_joker.when: Good in a Spade flush plan, with Smeared Joker or Arrowhead. Skip otherwise.

j_yorick.name: Yorick
j_yorick.what: Gains X1 Mult every 23 cards discarded.
j_yorick.when: Legendary; strong in discard heavy builds.

j_zany.name: Zany Joker
j_zany.what: +12 Mult if the played hand contains Three of a Kind.
j_zany.when: Good for trips and full house plans, weak if you rarely make trips.

bl_big.name: Big Blind
bl_big.what: Big Blind: base score 1.5x, reward $4, can be skipped for a tag.
bl_big.when: Skip for a high value tag when your score margin is large.

bl_small.name: Small Blind
bl_small.what: Small Blind: base score 1x, reward $3 (none on Red stake and up), can be skipped for a tag.
bl_small.when: Skip only for a tag that clearly beats the reward and extra shop; skipping removes a shop visit and interest chance.

c_ceres.name: Ceres
c_ceres.what: Levels up Flush House. Appears only after that hand has been played.
c_ceres.when: Take if you are on a flush house plan after you have made one.

c_earth.name: Earth
c_earth.when: Take for full house plans; +2 Mult +25 Chips per level.

c_eris.name: Eris
c_eris.what: Levels up Flush Five. Appears only after that hand has been played.
c_eris.when: Take if you are on a flush five plan after you have made one.

c_jupiter.name: Jupiter
c_jupiter.when: Take for flush plans; +2 Mult +15 Chips per level. Telescope often points here.

c_mars.name: Mars
c_mars.what: Levels up Four of a Kind.
c_mars.when: Take for four of a kind plans; +3 Mult +30 Chips per level.

c_mercury.name: Mercury
c_mercury.when: Take if you run a pair plan; each level gives +1 Mult and +15 Chips.

c_neptune.name: Neptune
c_neptune.when: Take for straight flush plans; +4 Mult +40 Chips per level. Also boosts royal flush combos.

c_planet_x.name: Planet X
c_planet_x.what: Levels up Five of a Kind. Appears only after that hand has been played.
c_planet_x.when: Take if you are on a five of a kind plan after you have made one.

c_pluto.name: Pluto
c_pluto.when: Take for high card plans; +1 Mult +10 Chips per level.

c_saturn.name: Saturn
c_saturn.when: Take for straight plans; +3 Mult +30 Chips per level.

c_uranus.name: Uranus
c_uranus.when: Take for two pair plans; +1 Mult +20 Chips per level.

c_venus.name: Venus
c_venus.what: Levels up Three of a Kind.
c_venus.when: Take for trips and full house plans; +2 Mult +20 Chips per level.

s_blue.what: Blue Seal: creates a Planet card for your last played hand if held in hand at end of round.
s_blue.when: Good for planet scaling when held; Trance applies it.

s_gold.what: Gold Seal: earns $3 when the card is played and scores.
s_gold.when: Good on a card you play every hand; early economy. Talisman applies it.

s_purple.what: Purple Seal: creates a Tarot card when discarded.
s_purple.when: Good in discard heavy plans; Medium applies it.

s_red.when: Best on cards that score big, like Steel Kings held with Mime or Glass cards. Deja Vu applies it.

c_ankh.name: Ankh
c_ankh.what: Creates a copy of a random joker and destroys the others.
c_ankh.when: Gamble; use only if you have one great joker and everything else is junk. Never with Blueprint-reliant boards.

c_aura.name: Aura
c_aura.what: Adds Foil, Holographic or Polychrome to 1 selected card.
c_aura.when: Edition on a card you play every hand; Polychrome is X1.5 Mult. Best on retrigger cards.

c_black_hole.name: Black Hole
c_black_hole.what: Upgrades every poker hand by 1 level.
c_black_hole.when: Always strong; use right away or hold with Perkeo. Best when all hand types matter.

c_cryptid.name: Cryptid
c_cryptid.what: Creates 2 copies of 1 selected card in hand.
c_cryptid.when: Strong: duplicate your best enhanced, edition and sealed card; builds five of a kind and Hologram, Idol and Steel stacks.

c_deja_vu.name: Deja Vu
c_deja_vu.what: Adds a Red Seal to 1 selected card.
c_deja_vu.when: Red Seal retriggers the card; best on steel kings or a face card with Photograph.

c_ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
c_ectoplasm.what: Adds Negative to a random joker, -1 hand size.
c_ectoplasm.when: An extra joker slot; take the hand size hit when jokers matter more than hand size. Prefer to have Juggler to offset.

c_familiar.name: Familiar
c_familiar.what: Destroys 1 random card in hand and adds 3 random Enhanced face cards.
c_familiar.when: Good for face decks and Hologram; thins junk and adds enhancements. Take in Pareidolia or Triboulet plans.

c_grim.name: Grim
c_grim.what: Destroys 1 random card in hand and adds 2 random Enhanced Aces.
c_grim.when: Good for Ace stacks and Scholar; adds Aces.

c_hex.name: Hex
c_hex.what: Adds Polychrome to a random joker and destroys the others.
c_hex.when: Use only with a single dominant joker (legendary or xMult); also a way to clear slots.

c_immolate.name: Immolate
c_immolate.what: Destroys 5 random cards in hand and gives $20.
c_immolate.when: Big money and thinning; use when your deck has junk and you are poor.

c_incantation.name: Incantation
c_incantation.what: Destroys 1 random card in hand and adds 4 random Enhanced numbered cards.
c_incantation.when: Good for numbered rank decks, Hologram and Fibonacci.

c_medium.name: Medium
c_medium.what: Adds a Purple Seal to 1 selected card.
c_medium.when: Purple Seal makes a Tarot when discarded; good for tarot scaling with discards.

c_ouija.name: Ouija
c_ouija.what: Converts all cards in hand to a single random rank, -1 hand size.
c_ouija.when: Strong for pair and five of a kind plans; the hand size hit is permanent, so offset with Juggler or Paint Brush.

c_sigil.name: Sigil
c_sigil.what: Converts all cards in hand to a single random suit.
c_sigil.when: Strong for flush plans; convert the whole hand. Pair with Ouija for a rank stack too.

c_soul.name: The Soul
c_soul.when: Always take and use if you have a slot. Appears in Arcana and Spectral packs rarely.

c_talisman.name: Talisman
c_talisman.what: Adds a Gold Seal to 1 selected card.
c_talisman.when: Put a Gold Seal on a card you play every hand, ideally retriggered or a Steel king. Early economy.

c_trance.name: Trance
c_trance.what: Adds a Blue Seal to 1 selected card.
c_trance.when: Blue Seal gives a Planet card if held in hand at end of round; good for planet scaling when held.

c_wraith.name: Wraith
c_wraith.what: Creates a random Rare joker and sets money to $0.
c_wraith.when: Use only if you have a joker slot and no need for the money; a free rare is strong. Avoid with a large bank.

black.what: Black Stake: shop jokers may be Eternal (cannot be sold or destroyed).
black.when: Check Eternal status on every offer; do not buy Eternal jokers that block a slot unless strong.

blue.when: Digging plans get weaker; prefer hand based plans.

gold.what: Gold Stake: shop jokers may be Rental ($3 per round).
gold.when: Rental jokers cost upkeep; only worth it when a joker wins you a blind soon.

green.when: More power needed by ante 5; stack xMult earlier.

orange.what: Orange Stake: shop jokers may be Perishable (debuffed after 5 rounds).
orange.when: Buy perishable jokers only for a short term payoff, and sell before they die.

purple.what: Purple Stake: faster blind scaling again.

red.what: Red Stake: the Small Blind gives no reward.
red.when: Less early money; skip Small Blinds more often.

eternal.what: Eternal: the joker cannot be sold or destroyed. Appears from Black Stake.
eternal.when: Do not buy as a temporary joker; blocks a slot forever. Only strong long term keepers are worth it. Safe from Madness, Ankh, Hex.

perishable.what: Perishable: the joker is debuffed after 5 rounds. Appears from Orange Stake.
perishable.when: Buy only for burst in the next 5 rounds; scaling ones lose value. Sell before it dies if you cannot use it.

rental.what: Rental: the joker costs $3 each round. Appears at Gold Stake.
rental.when: Only worth it when the joker pays for itself; a long hold bleeds interest.

tag_boss.name: Boss Tag
tag_boss.when: Worth it only to dodge a known bad boss.

tag_buffoon.name: Buffoon Tag
tag_buffoon.what: Gives a free Mega Buffoon Pack.

tag_charm.name: Charm Tag
tag_charm.what: Gives a free Mega Arcana Pack.
tag_charm.when: Good for tarot builds and steel or glass setups.

tag_coupon.name: Coupon Tag
tag_coupon.what: Initial cards and packs in the next shop are free.

tag_d_six.name: D6 Tag
tag_d_six.what: Rerolls in the next shop start at $0.

tag_double.name: Double Tag
tag_double.what: Gives a copy of the next tag you take.
tag_double.when: Strong before a great tag; Diet Cola creates one.

tag_economy.name: Economy Tag
tag_economy.when: Strong when you hold $20 or more.

tag_ethereal.name: Ethereal Tag
tag_ethereal.when: Good for Soul and Black Hole chances.

tag_foil.name: Foil Tag
tag_foil.what: Next base edition joker in the shop becomes Foil and free.

tag_garbage.name: Garbage Tag
tag_garbage.what: Earn $1 per unused discard this run.
tag_garbage.when: Good economy for stakes with discards unused.

tag_handy.name: Handy Tag
tag_handy.what: Earn $1 per hand played this run when taken.
tag_handy.when: Good economy mid run if you have played many hands.

tag_holo.name: Holographic Tag
tag_holo.what: Next base edition joker in the shop becomes Holographic and free.

tag_investment.name: Investment Tag
tag_investment.what: Gives $25 after defeating the next Boss Blind.

tag_juggle.name: Juggle Tag
tag_juggle.when: Weak skip tag unless tied to a hard blind.

tag_meteor.name: Meteor Tag
tag_meteor.what: Gives a free Mega Celestial Pack.

tag_negative.name: Negative Tag
tag_negative.what: Next base edition joker in the shop becomes Negative and free.
tag_negative.when: Strong skip early; a free slot.

tag_orbital.name: Orbital Tag
tag_orbital.what: Upgrades a shown hand type by 3 levels.
tag_orbital.when: Strong when it matches your plan hand.

tag_polychrome.name: Polychrome Tag
tag_polychrome.what: Next base edition joker in the shop becomes Polychrome and free.
tag_polychrome.when: Strong skip tag; free X1.5 Mult.

tag_rare.name: Rare Tag
tag_rare.what: Next shop has a free Rare joker.
tag_rare.when: Strong skip tag in any ante.

tag_skip.name: Skip Tag
tag_skip.what: Gives $5 for each blind skipped this run.
tag_skip.when: Strong the more you have skipped; best late.

tag_standard.name: Standard Tag
tag_standard.what: Gives a free Mega Standard Pack.

tag_top_up.name: Top-up Tag
tag_top_up.what: Creates up to 2 Common jokers if you have room.

tag_uncommon.name: Uncommon Tag
tag_uncommon.what: Next shop has a free Uncommon joker.
tag_uncommon.when: Worth a skip early, esp. with Baseball Card.

tag_voucher.name: Voucher Tag
tag_voucher.what: Adds a Voucher to the next shop.
tag_voucher.when: Good skip for a key voucher.

c_chariot.name: The Chariot
c_chariot.what: Enhances 1 selected card into a Steel card.
c_chariot.when: Core of steel builds: X1.5 Mult while held. Put it on Kings for Baron. Use on high ranks you will hold.

c_death.name: Death
c_death.what: Converts the left selected card into a copy of the right selected card.
c_death.when: Use to duplicate your best enhanced, edition or seal card, and to build rank stacks (pairs, five of a kind). Strong for flush color changes.

c_devil.name: The Devil
c_devil.what: Enhances 1 selected card into a Gold card.
c_devil.when: Gold cards give $3 held at end of round. Pair with Midas Mask and Ticket.

c_emperor.name: The Emperor
c_emperor.what: Creates up to 2 random Tarot cards.
c_emperor.when: Use early to fuel tarot builds when you have empty slots. Weak late.

c_empress.name: The Empress
c_empress.what: Enhances up to 2 selected cards into Mult cards.
c_empress.when: Fine for +4 Mult on scoring cards; best on cards you play every hand. Also feeds Vampire and Driver's License.

c_fool.name: The Fool
c_fool.what: Creates the last Tarot or Planet card used this run (not The Fool).
c_fool.when: Use when you have a great last card to copy such as a Planet for your main hand or Hermit. Keep one for a repeat of a key tarot; low priority otherwise.

c_hanged_man.name: The Hanged Man
c_hanged_man.when: Core thinning tool; use on weak cards, or to destroy steel-less duplicates. Key for Erosion, Caino, Ride the Bus and deck thinning.

c_heirophant.name: The Hierophant
c_heirophant.what: Enhances up to 2 selected cards into Bonus cards.
c_heirophant.when: +30 Chips on the card; low priority. Good for Driver's License or Vampire fodder.

c_hermit.name: The Hermit
c_hermit.what: Doubles your money, up to $20 extra.
c_hermit.when: Use when holding $10 or more, ideal at $20. Excellent economy tarot; do not use at low money.

c_high_priestess.name: The High Priestess
c_high_priestess.what: Creates up to 2 random Planet cards.
c_high_priestess.when: Strong in planet scaling; use immediately when you have free consumable slots. Good for a level boost on your main hand.

c_judgement.name: Judgement
c_judgement.when: Use when you have an open joker slot, ideally early for a free Rare chance. Skip if slots are full.

c_justice.name: Justice
c_justice.what: Enhances 1 selected card into a Glass card.
c_justice.when: Glass cannon builds: X2 Mult per glass card scored, with a 1 in 4 shatter chance. Pair with Oops, Glass Joker and Caino.

c_lovers.name: The Lovers
c_lovers.what: Enhances 1 selected card into a Wild card.
c_lovers.when: Wild cards count as every suit, so great for flush, Ancient Joker and Flower Pot plans. Put on scoring cards.

c_magician.name: The Magician
c_magician.what: Enhances up to 2 selected cards into Lucky cards.
c_magician.when: Take in Lucky card builds with Oops all 6s and Lucky Cat. Otherwise Lucky cards are volatile; skip in steel or glass plans.

c_moon.name: The Moon
c_moon.what: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Clubs.
c_moon.when: Use to change suits toward a Club flush plan.

c_star.name: The Star
c_star.what: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Diamonds.
c_star.when: Use to change suits toward a flush plan; Diamonds with Rough Gem and Greedy.

c_strength.name: Strength
c_strength.what: Increases the rank of up to 2 selected cards by 1.
c_strength.when: Use to make pairs, straights or Kings and Queens; turns 10s into Jacks. Excellent to build rank stacks and to change a rank for Triboulet or Baron.

c_sun.name: The Sun
c_sun.what: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Hearts.
c_sun.when: Use to change suits toward a Heart flush plan.

c_temperance.name: Temperance
c_temperance.what: Gives the total sell value of all jokers, up to $50.
c_temperance.when: Strong with Egg, Gift Card and expensive jokers; use before selling. Good late economy.

c_tower.name: The Tower
c_tower.what: Enhances 1 selected card into a Stone card.
c_tower.when: Stone cards give +50 Chips with no rank or suit. Core of stone builds with Stone Joker.

c_wheel_of_fortune.name: The Wheel of Fortune
c_wheel_of_fortune.what: 1 in 4 chance to add Foil, Holographic or Polychrome to a random joker.
c_wheel_of_fortune.when: Use with Oops all 6s for 1 in 2. Fine to use any time you have a spare slot; consumes without effect on failure. Never use if jokers already have editions you want.

c_world.name: The World
c_world.what: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Spades.
c_world.when: Use to change suits toward a Spade flush plan.

v_antimatter.name: Antimatter
v_antimatter.when: Strong at any point; one extra joker slot is a large power gain.

v_blank.name: Blank
v_blank.when: Needed only to unlock Antimatter. Skip unless the price is tiny.

v_clearance_sale.name: Clearance Sale
v_clearance_sale.what: All cards and packs in the shop cost 25% less.
v_clearance_sale.when: Good early if you shop heavily; skip when interest matters most.

v_crystal_ball.name: Crystal Ball
v_crystal_ball.when: Strong for tarot and planet builds that hold consumables; take early on Magic-less decks.

v_directors_cut.name: Director's Cut
v_directors_cut.what: Reroll the Boss Blind for $10, once per ante.
v_directors_cut.when: Useful when a boss wrecks the build and you have cash.

v_glow_up.name: Glow Up
v_glow_up.what: Editions appear 4x more often. Needs Hone.
v_glow_up.when: Strong for Polychrome and Negative hunting.

v_grabber.name: Grabber
v_grabber.when: Always good; take at the first chance. Helps every build.

v_hieroglyph.name: Hieroglyph
v_hieroglyph.when: Ante skip is strong early at a hand cost; best with Grabber or Burglar. Good when blind sizes outpace you.

v_hone.name: Hone
v_hone.what: Foil, Holographic and Polychrome appear 2x more often.
v_hone.when: Good for edition builds and Poly xMult hunting.

v_illusion.name: Illusion
v_illusion.what: Shop playing cards may have an enhancement, edition or seal. Needs Magic Trick.
v_illusion.when: Strong for deck building with enhanced cards.

v_liquidation.name: Liquidation
v_liquidation.what: All cards and packs in the shop cost 50% less. Needs Clearance Sale.
v_liquidation.when: Strong for a buy heavy run; good with Astronomer-less planet builds.

v_magic_trick.name: Magic Trick
v_magic_trick.what: Playing cards can appear in the shop.
v_magic_trick.when: Good for deck fattening and Hologram.

v_money_tree.name: Money Tree
v_money_tree.what: Raises the interest cap to $20 (hold $100). Needs Seed Money.
v_money_tree.when: Only for a long economy plan; takes time to earn back.

v_nacho_tong.name: Nacho Tong
v_nacho_tong.what: +1 more hand each round. Needs Grabber.
v_nacho_tong.when: Very strong for hand based plans.

v_observatory.name: Observatory
v_observatory.what: Planet cards in your consumable area give X1.5 Mult for their hand type. Needs Telescope.
v_observatory.when: Strong with Perkeo or a held planet for your main hand; requires keeping the planet unused.

v_omen_globe.name: Omen Globe
v_omen_globe.what: Spectral cards may appear in Arcana Packs. Needs Crystal Ball.
v_omen_globe.when: Good for Spectral hunting, Soul and Black Hole chances.

v_overstock_norm.name: Overstock
v_overstock_norm.when: Cheap and early; fine for hunting, take in ante 1 only if money is spare.

v_overstock_plus.name: Overstock Plus
v_overstock_plus.what: +1 more card slot in the shop. Needs Overstock.
v_overstock_plus.when: Only when you reroll hunt a lot; low priority.

v_paint_brush.name: Paint Brush
v_paint_brush.when: Strong at any point; more cards to play and hold.

v_palette.name: Palette
v_palette.what: +1 more hand size. Needs Paint Brush.

v_petroglyph.name: Petroglyph
v_petroglyph.what: -1 Ante again, -1 discard each round. Needs Hieroglyph.
v_petroglyph.when: A second ante skip at a discard cost; good for finishing.

v_planet_merchant.name: Planet Merchant
v_planet_merchant.what: Planet cards appear 2x more often in the shop.

v_planet_tycoon.name: Planet Tycoon
v_planet_tycoon.what: Planet cards appear 4x more often. Needs Planet Merchant.

v_recyclomancy.name: Recyclomancy
v_recyclomancy.what: +1 more discard each round. Needs Wasteful.
v_recyclomancy.when: Strong for digging plans, Yorick and Banner.

v_reroll_glut.name: Reroll Glut
v_reroll_glut.what: Rerolls cost $2 less again. Needs Reroll Surplus.
v_reroll_glut.when: Makes rerolls nearly free; strong with Flash Card.

v_reroll_surplus.name: Reroll Surplus
v_reroll_surplus.when: Great for reroll hunting and Flash Card builds; take early if you reroll.

v_retcon.name: Retcon
v_retcon.what: Reroll the Boss Blind as often as you like for $10. Needs Director's Cut.
v_retcon.when: Strong for guaranteed good boss; costly.

v_seed_money.name: Seed Money
v_seed_money.when: Take early in an economy run; pays back over many rounds.

v_tarot_merchant.name: Tarot Merchant
v_tarot_merchant.what: Tarot cards appear 2x more often in the shop.

v_tarot_tycoon.name: Tarot Tycoon
v_tarot_tycoon.what: Tarot cards appear 4x more often. Needs Tarot Merchant.

v_telescope.name: Telescope
v_telescope.what: Celestial Packs always contain the Planet for your most played hand.
v_telescope.when: Very strong for planet scaling in a one hand plan.

v_wasteful.name: Wasteful
v_wasteful.when: Good for flush and straight digging; take early.

blind_scaling.what: Blind score targets rise each ante. Small blind is 1x the base, Big 1.5x, Boss 2x (Wall 4x, Violet Vessel 6x). Stakes raise the base values. Boss reward is $5 and Big $4, Small $3.
blind_scaling.when: Plan the next boss: it is visible. Keep a spare hand type, Luchador or discard cover for known bad bosses.

boss_visible.what: The next boss is shown in advance at the blind select. Boss effects range from debuffing a suit to disabling hands or jokers.
boss_visible.when: Prepare for it in the preceding shop.

consumable_slots.what: 2 consumable slots by default. Crystal Ball and Negative consumables add 1; Nebula Deck removes 1.
consumable_slots.when: Free the slot before opening Arcana and Celestial packs. Planet builds that hold planets need extra slots.

deck_makeup.what: A standard deck has 52 cards: 13 ranks in 4 suits, one of each. Rank chips: 2 to 10 are face value, J Q K 10, Ace 11. Ace counts high or low in straights, not around the corner (Q K A 2 3 is not a straight).
deck_makeup.when: Know the make up before thinning or fattening: Erosion needs fewer than 52, Hologram and Blue Joker like more. Abandoned has 40 cards, Checkered only two suits.

hand_size.what: Default hand size is 8 cards drawn each round; you play up to 5 cards per hand. Hand size changes from jokers (Juggler +1, Troubadour +2, Turtle Bean +5, Stuntman -2, Merry Andy -1), vouchers (Paint Brush, Palette), decks (Painted +2) and Ouija or Ectoplasm (-1).
hand_size.when: Bigger hand size makes flushes and straights easier and holds more Steel or Baron cards. Do not drop under 6 without a reason.

hands_discards.what: Default 4 hands and 3 discards per round. Blue Deck +1 hand, Red Deck +1 discard, Black Deck -1 hand, Blue Stake -1 discard. Grabber and Nacho Tong add hands; Wasteful and Recyclomancy add discards.
hands_discards.when: Hands are the damage budget, discards are the dig budget. Unused hands and discards pay on Green Deck and some jokers.

interest.what: At the end of a round you earn $1 for every $5 held, up to $5 total (cap at $25 held). Seed Money raises the cap to $10 at $50, Money Tree to $20 at $100. To the Moon adds $1 per $5. Green Deck gets no interest.
interest.when: Hold $25 where you can early; spending below a $5 multiple loses interest. The bigger the cap the more it matters to bank early.

joker_order.what: Jokers resolve left to right. Each joker's Chips and Mult adds in that order and xMult multiplies the running total, so +Mult jokers go left of xMult jokers. Blueprint copies the joker on its right, Brainstorm the leftmost joker. Editions apply with the joker: Foil and Holographic add before the joker's own effect, Polychrome after.
joker_order.when: Order matters: +Mult first, then xMult. Put Blueprint directly left of your best xMult or retrigger joker and Brainstorm second with the best joker leftmost.

joker_slots.what: 5 joker slots by default. Antimatter and Black Deck add 1 each; Negative jokers add a slot; Painted Deck removes 1.
joker_slots.when: Slots are the real limit on power by mid run; sell weak jokers for better ones rather than hold filler. Negative cards are worth about a slot.

legendary.what: Legendary jokers (Canio, Triboulet, Yorick, Chicot, Perkeo) are only obtained from The Soul.
legendary.when: Always use The Soul when a slot is free.

packs.what: Booster packs hold a number of cards of which you choose some: Normal $4, Jumbo $6, Mega $8. You may skip a pack, which feeds Red Card.
packs.when: Open packs for your plan; skipping is allowed and sometimes better than filling a slot.

probabilities.what: Listed probabilities (Lucky, Glass, Wheel of Fortune, 8 Ball, Bloodstone, Business Card and so on) are doubled by Oops all 6s.

reroll_prices.what: A reroll costs $5 and rises by $1 on each reroll within a shop, then resets next shop. Reroll Surplus and Glut reduce the base by $2 each. Chaos the Clown gives one free reroll per shop.
reroll_prices.when: Reroll only when a specific piece is worth the cost relative to interest; stop when money would drop below an interest threshold you care about.

rounds_resource.what: A run is 8 antes of Small, Big and Boss blinds; winning ante 8 finishes the run. Each round gives a fixed number of hands and discards; skipping a blind skips its shop and reward but gives a tag.
rounds_resource.when: Rounds are the clock for scaling jokers and perishable or rental jokers. Count rounds when buying Perishable, Rental, Invisible Joker, Popcorn or Ice Cream.

scoring_order.what: Scoring order: played scoring cards left to right (rank chips, enhancement, edition, joker triggers on each card), then held in hand effects (Steel, Baron, Raised Fist), then jokers left to right including edition. Total is chips times mult.
scoring_order.when: Use to place jokers: held effects like Steel apply before joker xMult in the same hand.

sell_values.what: A joker or consumable sells for half its cost, rounded down, minimum $1. Egg and Gift Card raise sell value over time.
sell_values.when: Selling can pay for a key buy, and selling a spent scaler or a finished economy joker frees a slot.

shop_slots.what: The shop shows 2 card slots (jokers, tarot, planet, playing cards), 2 booster pack slots and 1 voucher slot. Overstock adds card slots. Only one voucher is offered per ante.
shop_slots.when: Check the voucher each ante; it is the only chance until the next ante.

skipping.what: Skipping a Small or Big blind gives its tag but no reward and no shop. The Boss cannot be skipped.
skipping.when: Skip only for a tag worth more than the reward plus shop; Throwback and Skip Tag reward skipping.
